findings.evidence: QLC+ looked for a sidecar fixture file named BlenderDMX-LED-PAR-64-RGBW.qxf beside the .qxw workspace. Snake-case files in a fixtures subdirectory were not resolved.

Initial generated QXF nested Channel elements inside Mode; QLC+ reported 'Will not add a NULL channel to mode Default'. The fixed QXF uses top-level Channel definitions and Mode Channel Number references, matching bundled QLC+ fixtures.
Initial QXW included a custom FixtureDefinition child. QLC+ reported it as an unknown fixture tag. Fixed QXW relies on Manufacturer/Model/Mode and sidecar QXF lookup.

evidence.notes: Empty function list is a valid QLC+ response and is now parsed as queried with zero functions.

findings.evidence: QLC+ 5.2.1 returns getChannelsValues records as channel/value/type/override groups, not a flat value list.
QLC+ Web API set/query commands use 1-based universe numbers; RayFlow stores universes as 0-based.

evidence.notes: QLC+ loaded the moving-head sidecar QXF without duplicate-channel or null-channel warnings after fine/duplicate channel names were made unique.

remaining_risk: Moving-head validation used Robe Robin MMX Blade only; iSpiiderX and other high-channel-count pixel fixtures may still expose fixture-specific QXF edge cases.
The disposable Scene was hand-added to the validation workspace. RayFlow does not yet generate QLC+ Scene/Function XML as a product feature.
